report_families.name: HollyResin EPC Dashboard
report_families.subtitle: XER / CSV route
report_families.project_ref: P151HRBP-L3-EPC-BL — Holly Resin Blend Plant EPC

parameters.name: XER_Folder
parameters.hint: Folder holding the 7 CSVs produced by Convert-XER.py

report_families.refresh_note: Drag a new .xer export onto Update-Dashboard.bat (or run it with no argument to pick up the newest .xer already in the folder). It shells out to Convert-XER.py, which rewrites the 7 CSVs, then re-open the .pbit or click Refresh.

report_families.name: HollyResinEPC (direct P6 XML)
report_families.subtitle: Direct P6 PM/XML route
report_families.project_ref: P151HRBP-L3-EPC-BL — Holly Resin Blend Plant EPC

parameters.name: XML_Folder
parameters.hint: A folder (newest .xml picked by Date modified) or a full path to one P6 PM/XML export file

parameters.name: BlendedRate
parameters.hint: $/hr used to price man-hours into cost

report_families.refresh_note: Export from P6 via File > Export > Primavera P6 XML (not .xer, not MS Project XML), drop the file in XML_Folder, then Refresh — the query always picks the newest .xml by Date modified.

report_families.name: HollyResinEPC EVA
report_families.subtitle: FTE, schedule status and cost EVA
report_families.project_ref: P151HRBP-L3-EPC-BL — Holly Resin Blend Plant EPC

parameters.name: XML_Folder
parameters.hint: A folder (newest .xml picked by Date modified) or a full path to one P6 PM/XML export file

parameters.name: BlendedRate
parameters.hint: $/hr used where the XER/XML carries no loaded rate

report_families.refresh_note: Same XML_Folder / BlendedRate parameters as the direct-XML dashboard. Contractor Type and Discipline/Contractor slicers filter all three EVA pages. 'Actual'/'Committed' read zero until the P6 export carries statused (progressed) activities — that is expected on a baseline schedule, not an error.

report_families.name: OpenPCS Power BI
report_families.subtitle: Project-controls workbook

parameters.name: WorkbookPath
parameters.hint: Full path to the OpenPCS Excel workbook — 30 named sheets loaded via Excel.Workbook()

report_families.refresh_note: Update the source rows in OpenPCS-Workbook.xlsx (Progress, Punch, ITRs, AWP_* sheets), set WorkbookPath to that file, then Refresh. Both zips contain the same OpenPCS.pbip project — the 'corrected' one just fixes an extra folder level.
